Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="A Necessary Bond Date" /> [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiate]] [[Gungi/Legends|Gungi]] created his own lightsaber aboard the [[Crucible/Legends|''Crucible'']], under the assistance of Professor [[Huyang/Legends|Huyang]].<ref name="AToS" /> He used it on [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]], in the [[Invasion of Florrum/Legends|Second battle of Florrum]].<ref name="ANB">{{TCW|A Necessary Bond}}</ref>
The weapon produced a green blade and was constructed of a metallic casing around the saber's internal components. The hilt was constructed of a layer of wood over the metal casing. The wood used was of the [[Brylark tree/Legends|Brylark tree]], whose bark was as strong as metal.<ref name="AToS" />
